decisions.reason: A camera close to the core offer with its own page in both years costs little to keep available, and its value is still emerging over long space procurement cycles.
Its flight heritage on the HERA mission partly resolves the uncertainty in its favour, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
Space situational awareness is a growing market and the product is still uncertain but promising, so keeping the option open is worth its modest cost.
A miniaturized LiDAR fits the firm's push toward compact sensors and small satellites, so this low-visibility option is worth holding while its value resolves.
A newly launched radiation-hard camera with its own page and close fit to the core offer is far too early to judge, so the firm keeps it.
This asteroid camera was just launched and is tied to deep-space missions like HERA, so its uncertain upside justifies retaining it at low cost.
